# model:     ams2
# outcome:   read
# source:    docs/CAPTURE_FINDINGS.md "Tray 0, Bambu-tagged spool" -- an AMS 2
#            preload scan under default settings (300 ms poll, 5-byte frames).
# verbatim:  abbreviated -- the doc records the chain with arrows and carries
#            the [AMS_*] tag on some elements only. The wording is the unit's.
#            REPLACE THIS FILE with a pasted host log when one is captured.
#
# The AMS 2 narrates the whole card sequence rather than the HT's single line,
# so there are four candidate moments to call a read and they are not together
# in time: auth, the flash write, read_done, and the feed completing.
#
# offset | expect | line
- | inflight      | [AMS_RFID]STEP2:pull tray 0 from switch
- | .             | pull tension nearly of 0
- | inflight      | [AMS_RFID]STEP3:start,read all card
- | inflight      | [AMS_RFID]STEP:card auth success!
- | read inflight | [RF] tray0: info write to flash
- | .             | read_done=1
- | read inflight | [AMS_RFID]STEP:feed with rfid success
- | end           | [AMS_RFID]STEP7:finish,cali tray
